title: Research construction: reuse R439 source sum for 2,880 fewer hosted instructions (no new kappa)
body:
Finite bit-supplier construction, **no new kappa**. Reuse the existing `17 ^= 87` sum in PR589's punctured R439 phase-B block at frame 509. The block falls from **31 to 26 XORs**; charging its literal reverse cleanup gives **24,305 → 24,295 ADDs per local call**. A complete fresh nine-stage replay reduces emitted instructions **7,843,392 → 7,840,512** (2,880 saved), with the same paid profile, charged precision invoice and bit exponent.

The eleven ordered outputs include arbitrary dirty carrier 468. All 661 register frame paths, 439 helpers, nine retained copies, rank mass 5,129 and original H1–H5 interface are preserved. Forward positive transfer is identical; reverse transfer is entrywise smaller. There are no extra wires or free source-access/restoration operations.

Only `research/p111-dirty-block509/` is added. Exact research/test base: **`f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631`**, which selects **PR799 with PR589**, conditional κ = 0.001661634653669567. Source heads, manifests, exact recipe, certificates, full costs, controls and attribution are included. OS seed **7**, bit-supplier track; no pinned coordination issue existed, so the claim is local.

The publication branch starts at the fork's existing ancestor `7ee02b7c96d85f22b38d28bd7ed49bb8c1aeb261`: the OAuth token cannot import unrelated newer upstream workflow files. Only this research addition is cherry-picked. All consumed supplier sources match the research base; the full local verifier and native source/input guards also pass on the publication branch. This PR changes no workflows.

Reproduce with standard-library Python 3.11+:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/p111-dirty-block509/verify.py
```

- All 2,048 local Boolean inputs, all 661 dirty-input columns, 636 closed frames, seven local controls, and original H1–H5.
- Fresh C++ legality and five/nine/eleven-stage checks on both words: 883/1,327/1,549 formal columns and 96 bridge-omission controls combined.
- Complete frozen nine-stage whole-owner and invoice replay: all 126,432 residuals hosted; 17 parent and 16 hosted mutation controls per word. `NATIVE.json` binds receipts, canonical words, 166 manifest payloads and the environment.
- Normal and optimized Python, minimal relocated replay, source/recipe/certificate/input corruption rejection, output preservation, Ruff, selected-record check and staged whitespace check.

No repository-wide suite, selected complex cold replay, full-theorem formalization, remote CI or practical runtime speedup is claimed. Inherited compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape and analytic assumptions remain. The selected frontier and `upstream/` are untouched.

Overlap refreshed through #842. PR728/792 concern R439 phase-A mini-nodes; R420/R480 block submissions concern different matrices. Their savings are not added here.
